title: ID0443864-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003340] Dual Charging Issue
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue:
On August 8, 2025, and August 13, 2025, between 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM, dual charging was not possible.
We can't currently integrate this into our daily routine. Yesterday, August 27, we experienced an outage between 5 and 6 p.m., even though there was only one truck at the charging station.
Solution: Logs are scrambled, it contains days of logs and it's very hard to troubleshoot. If problem reappears, reopen ticket.
Solution2: Mobile connection is low sometimes causing OCPP to drop

additional_info.subject: ID0443864-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003340] Dual Charging Issue CRM:02699000161
additional_info.body:
Hello Martin, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well today.
I checked the time you have provided 13/Aug after 6pm and here are my findings (be aware that the time difference is of 2h):
There is a session on DC2, which reaches 100% SoC, the vehicle is no longer asking for current as you can see 0 Ampere:
What we see in this log below is that in the DC2, there was a session stop request from the vehicle:
Right after we start a session in DC1 successfully:
Right before the session is finished, we see the vehicle dropping the request to 0 Ampere as well:
After this time, there were no more sessions.
In summary, there was never a parallel session since DC2 got to 100% SoC before the DC1 started.
--------
From the 8/Aug it's not very clear what happens because all the logs came at the same time since the charger was offline in our backend, so the charging sessions are mixed up.
My idea would be to reattempt a parallel charging again and give me a time to check the logs again since now the charger is online and all the logs will be collected correctly.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
